title: On The Silver Globe by Andrzej Zulawski

commenti.body: I saw it not too long ago and my head is still spinning. It’s a one-of-a-kind achievement…anyone that loves challenging, downright feral cinema ought to check it out for themselves (it was on YouTube when I myself watched it).

I remember looking forward to this for ages, but being unable to find a copy to watch. I eventually did and... unfortunately it didn't really click for me. Lots of interesting scenes and generally awesome visuals but it didn't add up to anything. It's filed in my memory with "Hard to be a God" for obvious reasons - a movie I enjoyed a bit more.
The documentary of the making of this movie is quite wild as well, I really really really really really really really really really really really really really really  recommend it.
Wow I have never heard of this? What’s the name of the doc and who made it? Link please?
It's called Escape to the Silver Globe, from 2021 https://www.imdb.com/title/tt15223788/
Oooh thank you for this! Will watch for sure!
